title: Frame Description Manifest
description: Container for a set of frame description entries produced for a Figma file pilot. SPEC-FIGMA-001 v0.2.0 (additive minor over v0.1.0; new optional pilot_metadata fields for SPEC-FIGMA-003 telemetry per REQ-NFR-02).

schema_version.description: Semver string for the schema this manifest was produced against. Minor bumps SHALL be additive only per REQ-NFR-02.

pm_reviewer_id.description: Identifier of the PM reviewer responsible for this pilot run.

pilot_date.description: ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the pilot session.

figma_file_ids.description: Figma file identifiers covered by this manifest.

total_token_cost.description: Aggregate generator token cost across all frames. Telemetry slot, no cost enforcement at schema level.

vision_call_count.description: Telemetry: number of Vision-augmented calls made (REQ-21, SPEC-FIGMA-003 AC-S4). Optional, additive in v0.2.0.

run_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 datetime of generation run; volatile field, normalized in determinism tests (AC-S12). Optional, additive in v0.2.0.

model_id.description: Pinned LLM model identifier per SPEC-FIGMA-003 REQ-NFR-05. Optional, additive in v0.2.0.

per_mode_breakdown.description: Telemetry breakdown by mode (node-only vs vision). Optional, additive in v0.2.0.

prompt_version.description: Prompt template version label per REQ-30. Optional, additive in v0.2.0.

prompt_git_sha.description: Active prompt template git SHA per REQ-30. Optional, additive in v0.2.0.

frames.description: Frame description entries. Producer contract requires sort by screen_id ascending under JSON-text byte comparison (REQ-03). screen_id uniqueness within this array is enforced by the validator post-pass (REQ-10).
